summary:
Banyan Base: Cuội & Moxi is a free browser game that trains kids aged 7–12 to think like mission planners. Based on the Vietnamese legend of Cuội, the woodcutter under the banyan tree on the Moon, players command a small lunar outpost for five shifts until a supply ship lands. Power, water and a water-bag storm shelter are linked: every choice helps one system and costs another. At the end, a solar particle storm, based on a real archived NASA DONKI record from May 2024, shows whether the player prepared early. A live Sun Watch ticker reads current DONKI space-weather data. In the Lab Quiz, kids answer plain-language questions about bones, muscles, immunity, radiation and plants to earn power, each linked to a related NASA OSDR study.

It answers the Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer challenge by teaching planning, trade-offs and delayed consequences through play. It matters because the next generation of explorers must understand risks like space radiation. The game runs offline, needs no account, and supports English, Tiếng Việt and 中文.
details:
What it does: Banyan Base is a browser game where kids (7–12) run a Moon outpost for five shifts. They share power, give Cuội jobs and answer Moxi's space-science questions in a Lab Quiz to earn energy. A solar particle storm, based on a real archived NASA DONKI record, tests whether they prepared early.

Benefits and impact: Kids learn planning, trade-offs and delayed consequences, plus real space-biology and radiation facts in plain words. Teachers get a free 10-minute class activity.

Tools: TypeScript, Vite, three.js, Web Audio (original generated music), Vitest (35 tests), NASA DONKI API, NASA OSDR search, Netlify, and Claude as an AI coding assistant.

Creative and considered: A Vietnamese legend turned into a mission trainer. Every choice helps one thing and costs another. Archived vs live NASA data is always labelled. Works offline with no account, in English, Tiếng Việt and 中文, with big touch targets.
dataRefs: Space Weather Database Of Notifications, Knowledge, Information (DONKI)
